description: The line plot illustrates the performance, measured as Micro F1 (%), of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—across four levels of generated sample sizes (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64). The x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is categorical and displays discrete values K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, with no numerical scale or tick intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is linear and ranges from 20 to 50, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50). The blue line with circle markers (TACRED) starts at approximately 23% at K=8, rises to 28% at K=16, peaks at 30.5% at K=32, and then slightly declines to 29.5% at K=64. The orange line with triangle markers (TACRED-Revisit) begins at 23.5% at K=8, increases to 29.5% at K=16, reaches 31% at K=32, and then drops slightly to 30% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers (Re-TACRED) starts at 34.5% at K=8, climbs to 42% at K=16, peaks sharply at 50.5% at K=32, and then decreases to 48% at K=64. The red line with square markers (SemEval) begins at 42% at K=8, rises steadily to 45% at K=16, reaches 47.5% at K=32, and continues increasing to 51.5% at K=64. All lines show generally upward trends, with Re-TACRED and SemEval exhibiting the highest performance, especially at K=32 and K=64.
